business_members_user_key.name: business_members_user_key
business_members_user_key.where: user_id is not null and deleted_at is null

expense_payments_reversed_check.name: expense_payments_reversed_check
expense_payments_reversed_check.value:
(reversed_at is null) = (reversed_by is null)
        and (reversed_at is null) = (reversal_date is null)

expenses_supplier_credit_check.name: expenses_supplier_credit_check
expenses_supplier_credit_check.value: payment_method <> 'supplier_credit' or supplier_id is not null

expenses_totals_check.name: expenses_totals_check
expenses_totals_check.value: net_total >= 0 and vat_total >= 0 and total = net_total + vat_total

expenses_review_check.name: expenses_review_check
expenses_review_check.value:
(submitted_at is null) = (submitted_by is null)
        and (approved_at is null) = (approved_by is null)
        and (rejected_at is null) = (rejected_by is null)
        and (rejected_at is not null or rejection_reason is null)
        and (status <> 'submitted' or submitted_at is not null)
        and (status <> 'approved' or approved_at is not null)
        and (status <> 'rejected' or rejected_at is not null)

expenses_posted_check.name: expenses_posted_check
expenses_posted_check.value:
(status in ('posted', 'reversed')) = (posted_at is not null)
        and (posted_at is null) = (posted_by is null)
        and (posted_at is null) = (vat_in_cost is null)
        and (posted_at is null) = (cost_total is null)

expenses_reversed_check.name: expenses_reversed_check
expenses_reversed_check.value:
(status = 'reversed') = (reversed_at is not null)
        and (status = 'reversed') = (reversed_by is not null)
        and (status = 'reversed') = (reversal_date is not null)

purchase_lines_unit_check.name: purchase_lines_unit_check
purchase_lines_unit_check.value:
case kind when 'material' then num_nonnulls(unit, pack_id) = 1
        else unit is null and pack_id is null and qty = 1
          and discount_percent is null and discount_amount is null end

purchase_lines_discount_check.name: purchase_lines_discount_check
purchase_lines_discount_check.value:
num_nonnulls(discount_percent, discount_amount) <= 1
        and discount_percent between 0 and 100 and discount_amount >= 0

purchase_payments_reversed_check.name: purchase_payments_reversed_check
purchase_payments_reversed_check.value:
(reversed_at is null) = (reversed_by is null)
        and (reversed_at is null) = (reversal_date is null)

purchase_returns_split_amount_check.name: purchase_returns_split_amount_check
purchase_returns_split_amount_check.value: split_amount is null or (kind = 'credit_note' and split_amount > 0)

purchase_returns_posted_check.name: purchase_returns_posted_check
purchase_returns_posted_check.value:
(status = 'draft') = (posted_at is null)
        and (status = 'draft') = (posted_by is null)
        and (status = 'draft') = (cost_total is null)

purchase_returns_reversed_check.name: purchase_returns_reversed_check
purchase_returns_reversed_check.value:
(status = 'reversed') = (reversed_at is not null)
        and (status = 'reversed') = (reversed_by is not null)
        and (status = 'reversed') = (reversal_date is not null)

purchases_paid_by_member_check.name: purchases_paid_by_member_check
purchases_paid_by_member_check.value: (payment_method is not distinct from 'paid_by_member') = (paid_by_member_id is not null)

purchases_supplier_credit_check.name: purchases_supplier_credit_check
purchases_supplier_credit_check.value: payment_method is distinct from 'supplier_credit' or supplier_id is not null

purchases_discount_check.name: purchases_discount_check
purchases_discount_check.value:
num_nonnulls(discount_percent, discount_amount) <= 1
        and discount_percent between 0 and 100 and discount_amount >= 0

purchases_posted_check.name: purchases_posted_check
purchases_posted_check.value:
(status = 'draft') = (posted_at is null)
        and (status = 'draft') = (posted_by is null)
        and (status = 'draft') = (vat_in_cost is null)
        and (status = 'draft') = (cost_total is null)

purchases_reversed_check.name: purchases_reversed_check
purchases_reversed_check.value:
(status = 'reversed') = (reversed_at is not null)
        and (status = 'reversed') = (reversed_by is not null)
        and (status = 'reversed') = (reversal_date is not null)

stock_movements_shape_check.name: stock_movements_shape_check
stock_movements_shape_check.value:
case kind
        when 'purchase' then qty > 0 and value >= 0 and purchase_line_id is not null
          and return_line_id is null and receipt_id is null and reverses_id is null
        when 'purchase_return' then qty < 0 and value <= 0 and purchase_line_id is not null
          and return_line_id is not null and receipt_id is not null and reverses_id is null
        when 'purchase_credit' then qty = 0 and value < 0 and purchase_line_id is not null
          and return_line_id is not null and receipt_id is not null and reverses_id is null
        else reverses_id is not null and receipt_id is null
      end
